notes.title: DEFINITIVE EDITION IS LIVE NOW!
notes.content:
Finally, after a lot of works,[b] DEFINITIVE EDITION [/b] is here.

Main features are:
- Fully reworked graphycs
- Fully reworked environments
- Improved Game Design
- Added more weapons
- Major and other minor improvements

The game will be continous improved with future updates following community feedbacks.
